lastCompletedStory.title: Refactor ConfigScreen to tabbed UI with per-tab model + effort selects

openQuestions: US-004 was the last story listed in scripts/cam/prd.json for this PRD (CAM-153/241, branch cam/issue-87) at the time this handoff was written; the supervisor should find no remaining passes:false non-operator stories and move to review.

commands/config.ts's mergeConfigChoices already unconditionally guards `if (choices.efforts !== undefined)` before writing [efforts] to project.toml -- since the tabbed ConfigScreen now ALWAYS populates choices.efforts (AC6), every `cam config` run will write an [efforts] section going forward (previously optional/wizard-dependent). This is the intended AC6 behavior, not a regression, but flagging it since it changes project.toml's on-disk shape for every project that re-runs `cam config` after this ships.

Discovered (not fixed, out of scope for this story): test/ui/tab-bar.test.tsx's 4 arrow-key sub-tests use a raw CSI sequence missing the leading ESC byte (e.g. stdin.write('[C') instead of '\x1b[C'), which Ink's keypress parser does not recognize as an arrow key at all (see parse-keypress.js's fnKeyRe, which requires ^\x1b+). Those assertions also only check a tab chip's label text, which TabBar renders regardless of active/inactive state -- so all 4 sub-tests would pass even if TabBar's Left/Right handling were completely broken. A future story should fix test/ui/tab-bar.test.tsx to use '\x1b[C'/'\x1b[D' and assert on content that only renders when a tab is truly active (see the non-tautological pattern used in the new test/ui/config-screen.test.tsx, and the two new patterns.md bullets on TabBar keypress-batching and Select's confirmed-mode options-lookup limitation).
nextStoryContext: US-004 completed the CAM-153/241 PRD's last listed story: src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx was fully refactored from the sequential forward-only wizard to a 7-tab TabBar-driven UI (6 phase tabs + Global), consuming US-003's TabBar and US-001's ConfigChoices.efforts/EFFORT_DEFAULTS. Key design points for anyone touching ConfigScreen.tsx next: (1) focus state is a (activeTab, fieldFocus) pair; the pure `computeNextFocus` helper (exported) implements the model->effort->next-tab chain and returns the literal string 'done' when advancing past Global's last field (notify-from), which the component treats as "submit" and fires onDone via the same setTimeout(0)-after-render pattern the old wizard used. (2) Only the ACTIVE tab's Section is ever mounted (not hidden-via-CSS) -- this is both how cross-tab keyboard isolation works (an inactive tab's Select has no live useInput) and the basis for non-tautological test assertions (check for a phase's `Model for <phase>:`/`Effort for <phase>:` question text, which only renders while that exact field is both mounted AND active). (3) Every Select-backed field except the model field uses Select's own `confirmed`/`confirmedValue` props for its inactive summary line; the model field uses the standalone `ConfirmedChoice` component instead, because a custom/free-text model id (US-002's 'custom / enter id' passthrough) is never a member of Select's fixed `options` array (see the new patterns.md bullet). (4) `buildTabDefs` and `computeNextFocus` are exported specifically so tests can assert against them directly instead of fighting terminal-width line-wrap in rendered Ink frames. (5) Two real gotchas discovered while writing the new test/ui/config-screen.test.tsx (both documented in patterns.md): a raw arrow-key CSI sequence needs the leading ESC byte to be recognized by Ink's keypress parser, and TabBar's plain (non-functional) `setState` call means rapid un-awaited Left/Right/Tab presses in a test collapse into a single net step -- every test keypress that depends on prior state must be individually awaited via `waitForFrame`. Since this was the PRD's final story, the natural next step is /cam-review, not another /cam-next story pick.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed useInput's key object exposes key.tab (boolean, Tab key) alongside the already-used leftArrow/rightArrow/upArrow/downArrow/return/escape booleans, matching the Tab-key focus-advance handler added in ConfigScreen.tsx.
